name: Cohere
description: Cohere is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Cohere is a privately held artificial intelligence company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing is a Series E round of up to $5 billion, the initial close of which was announced on October 29, 2026; Cohere has said the round would represent a valuation of $25.5 billion.

Founded in 2019 and based in Toronto, Cohere develops large language models and AI software for businesses and governments, which can be deployed within a customer's own computing environment. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except the Series C figure, which is as reported by Reuters, and the Series D figure, which is as reported by Bloomberg. The Series E valuation is the figure Cohere gave for the round if raised in full. Figures are in U.S. dollars; Cohere announced its Series E in Canadian dollars.
round_notes: The companies of Schwarz Group lead the Series E; when Cohere announced its combination with Aleph Alpha in April 2026, they committed $600 million of structured financing to the round. Cohere said its annual recurring revenue at the end of the third quarter of 2026 was 165% higher than a year earlier; that figure is the company's own. Cohere has not disclosed the amount committed at the initial close.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: The companies of Schwarz Group lead the Series E, with participation from Bell Ventures, Bullhound Capital, the Government of Canada, Inovia Capital, Nvidia and Prosperity7 Ventures. Radical Ventures and Inovia Capital led the August 2025 round, PSP Investments led the Series D and Inovia Capital led the Series C. Other investors include AMD Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Cisco, Oracle, Fujitsu and the Business Development Bank of Canada.
spv_sentence: Since 2023, three special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Cohere have filed with the SEC, none of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Cohere's announcements of its Series E (October 29, 2026), its combination with Aleph Alpha (April 24, 2026), and its August 2025 and September 2025 financings; its Series C announcement (June 8, 2023); reports by TechCrunch (July 2024), The Logic (July 2024) and Reuters (June 2023); reports by Bloomberg; and SEC Form D filings.
